name: stagehand-progress
description: Live progress of Stagehand playtests inside Claude Code: a band above the prompt, a detail pane, status line and toasts.

pollMs.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollMs.description: How often to poll the Stagehand daemon while a run is active.

autoOpen.title: Auto-open pane
autoOpen.description: Open the Stagehand pane when a run starts, where it docks beside the transcript (fullscreen).

notify.title: Notify on finish
notify.description: Raise a native notification when a run finishes.

historySize.title: Recent runs kept
historySize.description: How many finished runs the pane keeps under Recent.

logLines.title: Output lines
logLines.description: How many game log lines the pane's Output section shows.
